scripts.build: npm --prefix ./protocol run build && npm --prefix ./server run build && npm --prefix ./daemon run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix ./protocol run test && npm --prefix ./server run test && npm --prefix ./daemon run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix ./protocol run lint && npm --prefix ./server run lint && npm --prefix ./daemon run lint
scripts.test:server:relay: npm --prefix ./server run test -- server.test.ts framing.test.ts message-types.test.ts
scripts.test:daemon:v1: npm --prefix ./daemon run test -- daemon.test.ts history.test.ts workspace.test.ts file-change.test.ts
scripts.test:v1:backend: npm run test:server:relay && npm run test:daemon:v1
